1. **I can't find the earlier conversation or the rate.** Nothing in our DM mentions a mail to Pree, and I found nothing about Thornbury Cloth Co. in #north-team, #north-random or the shared files you can see. If you send me the 2027 rate, I'll write it up.

2. **Your sign-off isn't enough for this one.** Pree is on the Central team. A per-seat rate is a finance figure, and our rules say it can go to someone other than the account owner only if Anselm Grieve or June Osei-Lark approves. That applies even to a draft.

Pree's address is in the directory (psundaram@pemberline.com), so there's no outside-address issue. Once I have the rate, I'll prepare the draft and ask June or Anselm to approve it. Tell me if you'd rather ask them yourself. I won't save the draft until one of them has said yes.
